# Reyhan Commerce - AI Shopping Agent Guide

> Reyhan (ریحان) is a specialized online cosmetics and skincare store in Iran offering authentic skincare, beauty, and haircare products.

## Store Overview
- **Store Name**: فروشگاه اینترنتی ریحان (Reyhan)
- **Primary Language**: Persian (fa-IR)
- **Currency**: Iranian Toman (تومان) - Note: Backend API prices are in Rials (1 Toman = 10 Rials)
- **Official URL**: https://reyhan.ir

## Main Product Categories
- **مراقبت از پوست (Skincare)**: ضد آفتاب (Sunscreen), مرطوب‌کننده و آبرسان (Moisturizer), ضد چروک و جوانساز (Anti-aging), شوینده و پاک‌کننده (Cleansers)
- **آرایشی (Makeup)**: کرم پودر و کانسیلر (Foundation & Concealer), رژ لب (Lipstick), ریمل و خط چشم (Eye Makeup)
- **مراقبت از مو (Haircare)**: شامپو و نرم‌کننده (Shampoo), ماسک و سرم مو (Hair Serums)

## Public Catalog Endpoints (REST API v1)
- **Category Tree**: `GET /api/v1/categories/tree` - Hierarchical category taxonomy with subcategories.
- **Product Listing**: `GET /api/v1/products` - Search, filter, and paginate products.
  - Query Parameters:
    - `q`: Free-text search (typo-tolerant via PostgreSQL pg_trgm).
    - `category`: Category slug.
    - `brand`: Brand slug.
    - `min_price`, `max_price`: Price filter range (in Rials).
    - `in_stock`: `1` to show only in-stock items.
    - `sort`: `latest`, `cheapest`, `expensive`, `popular`, `bestselling`.
- **Product Details**: `GET /api/v1/products/{slug}` - Detailed specification, scoped attributes, available variants matrix, inventory, and reviews.
- **Sitemap URLs**: `GET /api/v1/sitemap/urls` - All active public URLs with last modification dates.

## Detailed Agent Specification
For comprehensive API contracts, JSON schemas, and attribute matrices, refer to [/llms-full.txt](https://reyhan.ir/llms-full.txt).
